==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Kangai Mau]] in the [[Brimhaven]] food store. {{Chat option|2I'm in search of adventure!|1Ok, I will get it back.}}
*Travel to [[Ardougne]] (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task), and head to the [[Gielinor_Parcel_Delivery_Team|GPDT]] depot just south of the eastern bank.
*Investigate the most [[crate (Tribal Totem)#Double|north-eastern crate]] for the [[address label]].
*Use the label on the [[crate (Tribal Totem)#Single|crate]] located 2 tiles to the south of the first crate.
*Talk to a [[GPDT employee]]. {{Chat option|1So, when are you going to deliver this crate?}}
*Talk to [[Wizard Cromperty]] in the house north-east of the Ardougne market with the checkered floor. {{Chat option|2So what have you invented?|2Can I be teleported please?|1Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!}}, or {{Chat option|2|2|1|1}} if you have completed the medium or higher [[Ardougne diaries]].
*Go west 2 doors and enter the password KURT. If you click too quickly it will say "This combination is incorrect", try again slower.
*Right-click '''Investigate''' the [[stairs (Tribal Totem)|stairs]], requiring 21 [[Thieving]], then climb them.
*Search the chest on the top floor for the [[totem]]. '''You must finish the dialogue.'''
*Return to Kangai Mau.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
